text: I'm mapping out my smart home setup for the landlord. Please connect Hub to Lamp and to Door with two arrows, then make the Lamp yellow so it's obvious which one is lighting. Is the Door directly linked to the Lamp, or only through the Hub?

Triage sends patients to Ward or to Icu depending on severity. So draw an arrow from Triage to each of them, and make Icu red because it is critical. Put a small white circle named Exit at the bottom of the canvas, where discharged people go, and link the Ward to it. Can you check if there is a path from Triage to Exit?

Nudge Shelf2 up by 40 pixels; it is too low compared to the other one. The Desk should be at the center of the room, I think. And one more thing, can you add a brown rectangle called Cart to the right of Desk? That is where returned books wait.

My supply chain is basically bread. The Farm feeds the Mill and the Mill feeds the Shop, so please chain them with arrows. Colour the Farm green, the Mill gray and the Shop orange, just to keep them apart. Then tell me which one has the fewest connections, if you would.

Uh so basically the mic goes into the mixer and the mixer goes into the amp, you know, the signal chain. Can you draw that, with Mic first? And the Mixer is the busy one so make it large. Also, what is the degree of the Mixer?

Please put a diamond called Expo between Kitchen and Pass, it is the checking station. Colour it navy and connect Kitchen to it. I will fix the other links later, no worries. And does Table1 count as a square on your end?

Gate1 and Gate2 need to sit on one horizontal line. Align them, then space them out evenly with the Lounge in between. If the lounge is too small, make it huge, and then recolor it indigo for the premium look. Is Gate2 to the right of Gate1 now?

for the chess club poster i want the Queen to be the biggest, then King a bit smaller. make the Pawn tiny please. then hook the king to the queen with a double headed arrow, cause they are together. is Pawn the smallest thing?

We study how a virus enters a cell, so I want an arrow from Virus to Cell. Throw a tiny red triangle near the Virus, as a spike protein. Then change the Cell to an ellipse and make it big. Tell me what is closest to the Cell afterwards.
Three layers: Ui, Service, Repo. Stack them in a column with arrows pointing down. After that, I want the Service in teal and Repo in brown. Does a cycle exist? It really shouldn't.

Dear assistant, could you kindly move the Booth to the top of the canvas? It is where the light operator sits. I would also like the Wings to be pushed left by 100 pixels, as the actors keep tripping. Finally, what colour is the Stage?

I'm planning my veg garden and want Bed1 and Bed2 as green rectangles. Fix them both, please. The Shed goes below the beds, small and brown. Hmm, also tell me whether any red shapes exist, I think I left a stray one.

The journey starts at Visit and ends at Buy, with Signup somewhere in between. Chain the three of them, and when that's done give the last link the label "convert". Make Buy gold, because that's the money step. Does anything point out of Buy?
Get rid of the Enemy, I decided the level is peaceful. The Hero should be a star now, and bigger too. Slide the Potion to the right of Hero and colour it magenta. How many shapes remain?

For my geography quiz make France the center piece. Spain should go to the left of France, and Italy to the right of it, roughly. Then give Italy a green colour and Spain an orange one. Could you tell me which country is rightmost?

For the festival layout, I need 3 gray squares as food stalls arranged in a row. Then put the Bar next to the Entry. Hmm, and the stage is too close to the Bar, so move the Stage to the top. Nice, thanks. Is the Entry bigger than the Bar?

Circuit sketch: connect the Battery to the Resistor and the Resistor to the Led, in this order. Make the Led red and keep it small. I'd like the Battery drawn as a tall rectangle, so change its shape. Is the Led connected to the Battery directly?
okay so Rose is the mom, Tom is the dad and Jim is the kid. Draw a line from Rose to Jim and another from Tom to Jim, ok? Make Jim blue, he's a boy, I guess. And then rename Jim to Jimmy.

Slide the Tills down 50 pixels, they are blocking the way in. Then duplicate Aisle1 twice, because we have three aisles in total, and arrange all the aisles in a row. Does Entrance sit above the Tills at this point?

Kickoff, then Design, then Launch: that's the whole plan, nothing fancy. Link them up in that order with arrows. The Launch date is crucial so make it huge and red. What is the leftmost shape, just to be sure the order reads left to right?

This is a diagram of an eclipse. The Moon should be between Earth and Sun, so please move it there. Colour the Moon black, which is what it looks like in the shadow. Then connect the Sun to the Moon with a dashed line, and I'll add the labels myself.

Mockup of a mail app: put Inbox at the left and Compose at the top. I want the Profile bubble as a circle in the top right. Colour it pink. Wait, is the Inbox actually bigger than Compose at the moment?

Attach the Spring to the Wall and the Mass to the Spring. I'd like those drawn without any arrowheads, since springs are not directional. Make Mass large and navy, it's the heavy part. Which shape is the topmost one?

Rack1 and Rack2 look sloppy. Line them up vertically and stack them in a column, and the Dock goes at the bottom. If the racks come out too big I will want them small. How many rectangles are on the board right now?
Stick a lime circle named Basil above Pizza, it's the garnish. Then link Dough to Oven and the Oven to Pizza with arrows. The Oven should be red, it's hot, after all. What does Oven touch?
Connect Office to Vpn with a dashed line and Vpn to Cloud with another one. The tunnel should stay secret, so make both lines blue... Actually just the second one blue. Does Cloud reach Office?

Wire the timetable up: Math, Lunch and Art, in that order, with one arrow after another. Lunch deserves to be orange and bigger than the rest. Rename Art to Drawing, since that is how the kids call it. Is there a cycle in the timetable?

Item belongs to Order, and Order belongs to User, so point the arrows from Item to Order and from Order to User. Make the three of them squares. I'd like a hexagon called Audit in gray near the User as well. What is User's degree?

The lions need to stay far from the zebras, obviously. Put Lions on the left of the canvas and Zebras on the right. Then make the Cafe sit between them, and colour it white. Honestly I might change that later, but let's try.

Make all the cards on the board small, the board is crowded. I mean all the squares. And Done should be green, naturally. After you finish that, bring Doing to the front. Is there any triangle on here?

Mind map for finals week. All the circles should be orange now, I'd say, so recolor them. Draw a link from Study to Notes and one from Study to Exams. Oh, and shrink the Notes one, it's not that important. Which shape is mostConnected here?
Turn the diagram into a loop: Off to On, On to Standby, Standby to Off. The Standby state should be a diamond and indigo, because it is conditional. Can you describe the Off state for me afterwards?
A quick one from the airport: place a red hexagon called Stop at the bottom right. Join Decide to it with a dotted arrow. Then toss Write behind everything else, I mean to the back. Is Stop red?

Saturn needs a ring, which we already have, so move the Ring so that it is near Saturn. Make the Ring gold and small. Titan is a moon, so create nothing there but shrink Titan. Where is Saturn, by the way, relative to Titan?

hiring flow: Apply -> Interview -> Offer. i want those chained please. and the Offer step should be the green one. also add a gray circle named Reject below Interview and connect Interview to it with a dashed line. Is Interview bigger than Offer?

Beware the Swamp: turn it brown, then put the Tower in the top left corner. I'd like the Keep drawn bigger than the Tower. Delete the Swamp after you coloured it? No, keep it, I changed my mind. Which one is the nearest to the Keep?
Modem goes to Router, Router goes to Tv. That's the entire wiring. Put the three in a row, and make sure the Tv is cyan, please. And finally, is the Tv reachable from the Modem?

The plant diagram needs polishing. Colour the Root brown and the Leaf green. Move the Stem so it sits between the Root and the Leaf, then link the stem to each, using plain lines. Is the Root below the Leaf?
After Record comes Edit, after Edit comes Publish, as you know. Draw each arrow. Everything should be teal for the brand, so recolor everything. Then add the label "v2" to the Edit box.
Make a copy of Api, because we are scaling out. Place the new one to the right of the original Api, and tie both to Db with arrows. Which shape is the most connected now?

Semi1 and Semi2 both lead to the Final, so connect them. The Final trophy should be gold and huge. I'm going to move on to quarterfinals after this, so please remember the Semis are circles. Turn them into circles, okay?
We have four desks, so make two more copies of Desk1. Put the printer between Desk1 and Desk2. Honestly just spread everything out evenly along the horizontal axis. Is the Printer near Desk1?

The attacker tries to get through the firewall to the server. Draw a red dashed arrow from Attacker to Firewall. Then make the Firewall huge and orange, because it's the hero here. Could you tell me the path from Attacker to Server, if there is one?
Disconnect Ada from Bob, they divorced. Then Cy, who is Ada's kid, should hang off Ada only. So link Ada to Cy and colour Cy purple. Who does Ada touch now?
For the harmony lesson I need the Tonic in the middle, the Dominant on the right and the Subdominant on the left. Make them all circles. And give the Tonic a nice yellow, it feels like home.

Box1 is blue, Box2 is red, and Box3 is green. That's how the real boxes look. Please make the canvas match that, then label each of them with its own number like "1". Actually just label Box1 with that one, I will do the rest.

Colour the Sensor lime and place it below the Gateway. The Dash is where everything ends up, so connect Gateway to it. Oh and what do you know, I forgot the arrows from the sensor, so connect it to Gateway too. How many connections do we have?

Teaching grammar with shapes, so the Noun is a square, the Verb is a circle, and the Adjective is a triangle. Please fix any that are wrong. Then draw an arrow from Adjective to Noun. Is there something that is a triangle?
Both Bus and Train go to the Station, so do two arrows. The train line is dotted, it's the planned one. Move Station to the center and shrink it a bit. What is the degree of Station when you're done?

Okay so the order is Church, then Hall, then the Hotel. Chain them with arrows. I'm thinking of making the Hall huge, since it's where everyone dances. Oh, and a pink star called Cake near the Hall would be perfect.
